items.title: Orwell: 2+2=5
items.overview: George Orwell was one of the most visionary authors of the 20th century, whose novels 1984 and Animal Farm foretold a chilling, authoritarian future. Acclaimed director Raoul Peck interweaves clips, readings from Orwell's diary, cinematic references, and modern-day footage to craft not only a portrait of the writer, but a fresh take on how prophetic his work has become.

items.title: Mexico 86
items.tagline: Not all goals are scored on the field.
items.overview: When a last-minute chance to host the 1986 World Cup appears, a cunning Mexican bureaucrat, armed with nothing but guts and audacity, cons his way through FIFA to beat the United States, but in a country of power games, every victory has a price.

items.title: Run Sweetheart Run
items.tagline: A first date from hell.
items.overview: A woman runs for her life though the streets of Los Angeles after her blind date suddenly turns violent.

items.title: The Siege of Jadotville
items.tagline: The Irish army's forgotten battle
items.overview: Irish Commandant Pat Quinlan leads a stand off with troops against French and Belgian Mercenaries in the Congo during the early 1960s.

items.title: Crater
items.tagline: Miles from Earth, their adventure begins.
items.overview: After the death of his father, a boy growing up on a lunar mining colony takes a trip to explore a legendary crater, along with his four best friends, prior to being permanently relocated to another planet.

items.title: The Postman
items.tagline: Dreams do come true.
items.overview: Simple Italian postman learns to love poetry while delivering mail to a famous poet; he uses this to woo local beauty Beatrice.

items.title: Mars Needs Moms
items.tagline: Mom needs a little space.
items.overview: When Martians suddenly abduct his mom, mischievous Milo rushes to the rescue and discovers why all moms are so special.

items.title: The Man Who Killed Don Quixote
items.tagline: Today's a marvelous day for adventures!
items.overview: Toby, a cynical film director finds himself trapped in the outrageous delusions of an old Spanish shoe-maker who believes himself to be Don Quixote. In the course of their comic and increasingly surreal adventures, Toby is forced to confront the tragic repercussions of a film he made in his idealistic youth.

items.title: Mickey's Magical Christmas: Snowed in at the House of Mouse
items.overview: When a huge snowstorm leaves everyone stranded, Mickey and all of his guests at the House of Mouse, including Pooh, Belle, Snow White, Cinderella, Ariel and many more of his old and new friends, break out the cookies and hot chocolate to help Donald mend his tattered Christmas spirit.

items.title: Tom and Jerry: A Nutcracker Tale
items.tagline: Ballet meets mayhem in the ultimate nutcracker battle!
items.overview: Christmas is never so spirited as when Tom and Jerry lock horns for the holidays in their new original movie--Tom & Jerry: A Nutcracker Tale In an empty opera house, Jerry wishes for a chance to perform -- and magically his dream comes true. The little mouse is whisked away to an enchanted kingdom where anything is possible: candy forests, singing snowflakes, even the toys spring to life! Jerry has a great time with his new friends, and when Jerry dances with the music box ballerina, he is as happy as happy can be. Unfortunately, alley cats led by Tom crash Jerry's party, kidnap the music box ballerina and wreak havoc in the holiday kingdom. It's up to Jerry to set things right -- and with help from a fellow mouse named Tuffy and more newfound friends, Jerry just may win the day!

items.title: Sharpay's Fabulous Adventure
items.overview: After a talent scout spots her performing with her dog Boi at a charity gala, Sharpay Evans sets off for the bright lights of NYC, convinced instant fame and fortune are in the bag. But theatre's a dog-eat-dog world. Fortunately, Sharpay also meets Peyton, a handsome student filmmaker who finds Sharpay nearly as fascinating as she finds herself.

items.title: The Panic in Needle Park
items.tagline: God help Bobby and Helen, they're in love in Needle Park
items.overview: A stark portrayal of life among a group of heroin addicts who hang out in Needle Park in New York City. Played against this setting is a low-key love story between Bobby, a young addict and small-time hustler, and Helen, a homeless girl who finds in her relationship with Bobby the stability she craves.

items.title: Royal Tramp
items.overview: The story of Wai Siu Bo, a pimp who after saving Chan Kan Nam, the leader of the Heaven and Earth society, a revolutionary group, is made a member. After a botched first assignment for the group, he is made a servant to the Prince, the very person the Heaven and Earth society want to overthrow. What follows is plenty of mayhem and laughter.

items.title: Medieval
items.tagline: For honor. For justice. For freedom.
items.overview: The story of fifteenth century Czech icon and warlord, Jan Zizka, who defeated armies of the Teutonic Order and the Holy Roman Empire.

items.title: The Unjust
items.tagline: Justice is a deal.
items.overview: An honest cop has to compromise with his principles when he is told to find a scapegoat for a high-profile serial killer case in exchange for a big promotion.

items.title: The Land That Time Forgot
items.tagline: THE ADVENTURE YOU WILL NEVER FORGET!
items.overview: During World War I, a German U-boat sinks a British passenger ship and takes the survivors aboard. After getting lost in fog, the submarine surfaces near the unknown island of Caprona, a lost world where they find dinosaurs and Neanderthals.

items.title: [REC]³ Genesis
items.tagline: You may kiss the bride...
items.overview: A pair of newlyweds must fight to survive when their wedding reception descends into chaos and carnage when their guests become infected by a virus that turns them into hungry zombies.

items.title: Child of Kamiari Month
items.overview: A year after losing her mother, a young girl learns that she must journey across Japan to the annual gathering of gods in the sacred land of Izumo.

items.title: Chief of Station
items.tagline: Revenge knows no limits.
items.overview: After learning that the death of his wife was not an accident, a former CIA Station Chief is forced back into the espionage underworld, teaming up with an adversary to unravel a conspiracy that challenges everything he thought he knew.

items.title: A Babysitter's Guide to Monster Hunting
items.overview: Recruited by a secret society of babysitters, a high schooler battles the Boogeyman and his monsters when they nab the boy she's watching on Halloween.

items.title: Tomboy
items.tagline: There's a new kid in town.
items.overview: Ten-year-old Laure isn't like most girls. She prefers football to dolls and sweaters to dresses. When Laure and her family move to a new neighbourhood, local girl Lisa mistakes Laure for a boy. Indulging in this exciting new identity, Laure becomes Mickaël, and so begins a summer of long sunny afternoons, playground games and first kisses. Yet with the school term fast approaching, and with suspicions arising amongst friends and family, Laure must face up to an uncertain future.

items.title: Zeros and Ones
items.tagline: It's always deadliest before the dawn.
items.overview: Called to Rome to stop an imminent terrorist bombing, a soldier desperately seeks news of his imprisoned brother — a rebel with knowledge that could thwart the attack. Navigating the capital's darkened streets, he races to a series of ominous encounters to keep the Vatican from being blown to bits.

items.title: Hotel Mumbai
items.tagline: November 26, 2008… Terror struck the heart of India.
items.overview: Mumbai, India, November 26, 2008. While several terrorists spread hatred and death through the city, others attack the Taj Mahal Palace Hotel. Both hotel staff and guests risk their lives, making unthinkable sacrifices to protect themselves and keep everyone safe while help arrives.

items.title: Think Like a Dog
items.overview: A 12-year-old tech prodigy, whose science experiment goes awry, forges a telepathic connection with his best friend, Henry-his dog! The duo join forces and use their unique perspectives on life to comically overcome complications of family and school.

items.title: C'est la vie!
items.overview: Max is a battle-weary veteran of the wedding-planning racket. His latest — and last — gig is a hell of a fête, involving stuffy period costumes for the caterers, a vain, hyper- sensitive singer who thinks he's a Gallic James Brown, and a morose, micromanaging groom determined to make Max's night as miserable as possible. But what makes the affair too bitter to endure is that Max's colleague and ostensible girlfriend, Joisette, seems to have written him off, coolly going about her professional duties while openly flirting with a much younger server. It's going to be a very long night… especially once the groom's aerial serenade gets underway.

items.title: The Lady Vanishes
items.tagline: Comedy! Chills! Chuckles! in a Mystery Express!
items.overview: On a train headed for England a group of travelers is delayed by an avalanche. Holed up in a hotel in a fictional European country, young Iris befriends elderly Miss Froy. When the train resumes, Iris suffers a bout of unconsciousness and wakes to find the old woman has disappeared. The other passengers ominously deny Miss Froy ever existed, so Iris begins to investigate with another traveler and, as the pair sleuth, romantic sparks fly.

items.title: The Personal History of David Copperfield
items.tagline: From rags to riches... and back again.
items.overview: A fresh and distinctive take on Charles Dickens’ semi-autobiographical masterpiece, The Personal History of David Copperfield, set in the 1840s, chronicles the life of its iconic title character as he navigates a chaotic world to find his elusive place within it. From his unhappy childhood to the discovery of his gift as a storyteller and writer, David’s journey is by turns hilarious and tragic, but always full of life, colour and humanity.

items.title: The Dirt
items.tagline: Their music made them famous. Their lives made them Infamous.
items.overview: The story of Mötley Crüe and their rise from the Sunset Strip club scene of the early 1980s to superstardom.

items.title: Fantastic Voyage
items.tagline: A Fantastic and Spectacular Voyage... Through the Human Body... Into the Brain.
items.overview: In order to save an assassinated scientist, a submarine and its crew are shrunk to microscopic size and injected into his bloodstream.

items.title: Cyborg She
items.tagline: Is This Love Or Just Programming?
items.overview: A lonely university student develops a romance with a beautiful interesting woman, who turns out to be a cyborg from the future.

items.title: The Deep Blue Sea
items.tagline: Beware of passion...
items.overview: The wife of a British Judge is caught in a self-destructive love affair with a Royal Air Force pilot.

items.title: HOUBA! On the Trail of the Marsupilami
items.overview: When reporter Dan Geraldo arrives in Palombia to hunt for a scoop, he never suspects that he is about to make an incredible discovery... With his resourceful local guide Pablito, D an has one surprise after another during a thrilling adventure that allows him to bring the world some spectacular news: the Marsupilami, a mythical and mischievous animal, really does exist! You too will believe in furry tails!

items.title: Bernie
items.tagline: A story so unbelievable it must be true.
items.overview: In small-town Texas, affable and popular mortician Bernie Tiede strikes up a friendship with Marjorie Nugent, a wealthy widow well known for her sour attitude. When she becomes controlling and abusive, Bernie goes to great lengths to remove himself from her grasp.

items.title: The Last Seduction
items.tagline: Most People Have a Dark Side. She Had Nothing Else.
items.overview: A devious femme fatale steals her husband’s drug money and hides out in a small town where she meets the perfect dupe for her next scheme.

items.title: Bachelorette
items.tagline: Old habits party hard.
items.overview: Three friends are asked to be bridesmaids at a wedding of a woman they used to ridicule back in high school.

items.title: Against the Ice
items.tagline: Survive the search. Survive each other.
items.overview: In 1909, two explorers fight to survive after they're left behind while on a Danish expedition in ice-covered Greenland.

items.title: Frivolous Lola
items.tagline: A determined young virgin is on the loose...
items.overview: In 1950s northern Italy, a woman tests her fiancé's love and passion by trying to break his commitment to premarital chastity.

items.title: The Power of One
items.tagline: An exhilarating epic of a triumph of the heart.
items.overview: PK, an English orphan terrorized for his family's political beliefs in Africa, turns to his only friend, a kindly world-wise prisoner, Geel Piet. Geel teaches him how to box with the motto “fight with your fists and lead with your heart”. As he grows to manhood, PK uses these words to take on the system and the injustices he sees around him - and finds that one person really can make a difference.

items.title: Vixen!
items.tagline: Is she woman... or animal?
items.overview: In a Canadian mountain resort, Vixen Palmer resides with her naive pilot husband Tom. While he's away flying in tourists, she sleeps with practically everybody including a husband and his wife, and even her biker brother. However, the only one she won't bed is her brother's friend... who is Black.

items.title: Saint Seiya Heaven Chapter: Overture
items.overview: After the bloody battle against Hades, the goddess Athena and her saints are still recovering when they find themselves face to face with their newest and most formidable foe: the dreadful moon goddess Artemis. Artemis replaces Athena as the earth guardian deity and takes over the Sanctuary, turning Athena's Saints into her servants.  Upon invading the Sanctuary, the Bronze Saints learn that Athena was banished by Artemis and decide to fight the moon goddess in order to rescue their true goddess and free the Earth from Artemis's ominous control.

items.title: The Bishop's Wife
items.tagline: Have you heard about Cary and the bishop's wife?
items.overview: An Episcopal Bishop, Henry Brougham, has been working for months on the plans for an elaborate new cathedral which he hopes will be paid for primarily by a wealthy, stubborn widow. He is losing sight of his family and of why he became a churchman in the first place. Enter Dudley, an angel sent to help him. Dudley does help everyone he meets, but not necessarily in the way they would have preferred. With the exception of Henry, everyone loves him, but Henry begins to believe that Dudley is there to replace him, both at work and in his family's affections, as Christmas approaches.

items.title: Scarface
items.tagline: The rise and fall of a power hungry mobster.
items.overview: In 1920s Chicago, Italian immigrant and notorious thug, Antonio 'Tony' Camonte, aka Scarface, shoots his way to the top of the mobs while trying to protect his sister from the criminal life.

items.title: The Hard Way
items.tagline: There's only one way these two are going to get along...
items.overview: Seeking to raise his credibility as an actor and to land a role as a tough cop on a new show, Hollywood action star Nick Lang works a deal with New York City Police Capt. Brix, who by chance is one of his fans. Nick will be paired with detective Lt. John Moss and learn how to act like a real cop. But when Nick drives John crazy with questions and imitating him, he gets in the way of John's pursuit of a serial killer.

items.title: My Big Fat Greek Wedding 2
items.tagline: People change. Greeks don't.
items.overview: The continuing adventures of the Portokalos family. A follow-up to the 2002 comedy, "My Big Fat Greek Wedding."
items.collection: My Big Fat Greek Wedding Collection

items.title: Poison
items.tagline: One bed. One snake. Zero room for error.
items.overview: When a poisonous snake slithers onto an Englishman's stomach in India, his associate and a doctor race to save him.

items.title: Exotica
items.tagline: In a world of temptation, obsession is the deadliest desire.
items.overview: In the upscale Toronto strip club Exotica, dancer Christina is visited nightly by the obsessive Francis, a depressed tax auditor. Her ex-boyfriend, the club's MC, Eric, still jealously pines for her even as he introduces her onstage, but Eric is having his own relationship problems with the club's female owner. Thomas, a mysterious pet-shop owner, is about to become unexpectedly involved in their lives.

items.title: Science Fiction Volume One: The Osiris Child
items.overview: Set in the future in a time of interplanetary colonization, an unlikely pair race against an impending global crisis and are confronted by the monsters that live inside us all.

items.title: Mr. Smith Goes to Washington
items.tagline: Romance, drama, laughter and heartbreak... created out of the very heart and soil of America!
items.overview: After the death of a United States Senator, the idealistic Jefferson Smith is appointed as his replacement in Washington. The naive and earnest new senator soon finds himself battling political corruption.

items.title: Young Sherlock Holmes
items.tagline: Before a lifetime of adventure, they lived the adventure of a lifetime.
items.overview: Sherlock Holmes and Dr. Watson meet as boys in an English Boarding school. Holmes is known for his deductive ability even as a youth, amazing his classmates with his abilities. When they discover a plot to murder a series of British business men by an Egyptian cult, they move to stop it.

items.title: The Wall
items.tagline: This isn't war. It's a game.
items.overview: An American sniper and his spotter engage in a deadly cat-and-mouse game with an Iraqi sniper.

items.title: Paradise
items.tagline: If only it could have been forever.
items.overview: After their caravan is attacked and their respective families butchered by Arab marauders, teenagers David and Sarah flee across the desert. But the desert is filled with danger from the elements, animals and the unwholesome appetite of the Jackal, a sheik who wants Sarah for himself. However, the desert also holds temptation and love. David and Sarah hide out in an oasis and build a life for themselves, discovering each other in new ways.

items.title: The Science of Sleep
items.tagline: Close your eyes. Open your heart.
items.overview: A man entranced by his dreams and imagination is lovestruck with a French woman and feels he can show her his world.

items.title: Whatever Works
items.tagline: A new comedy!
items.overview: Whatever Works explores the relationship between a crotchety misanthrope, Boris and a naïve, impressionable young runaway from the south, Melody. When Melody's uptight parents arrive in New York to rescue her, they are quickly drawn into wildly unexpected romantic entanglements. Everyone discovers that finding love is just a combination of lucky chance and appreciating the value of "whatever works."

items.title: Justice League Dark
items.tagline: When demons invade our world, the key to justice is in the shadows.
items.overview: When innocent civilians begin committing unthinkable crimes across Metropolis, Gotham City and beyond, Batman must call upon mystical counterparts to eradicate this demonic threat to the planet; enter Justice League Dark. This team of Dark Arts specialists must unravel the mystery of Earth's supernatural plague and contend with the rising, powerful villainous forces behind the siege—before it's too late for all of mankind.

items.title: The In Between
items.tagline: Love never dies.
items.overview: After surviving a car accident that took the life of her boyfriend, a teenage girl believes he's attempting to reconnect with her from the after world.

items.title: The Robe
items.tagline: The first motion picture in CinemaScope--the modern miracle you see without glasses!
items.overview: Drunk and disillusioned Roman, Marcellus Gallio, wins Jesus' robe in a dice game after the crucifixion. Marcellus has never been a man of faith like his slave, Demetrius, but when Demetrius escapes with the robe, Marcellus experiences disturbing visions and feels guilty for his actions. Convinced that destroying the robe will cure him, Marcellus sets out to find Demetrius — and discovers his Christian faith along the way.

items.title: Voyagers
items.tagline: What does it feel like?
items.overview: With the future of the human race at stake, a group of young men and women -- bred for intelligence and obedience -- embark on an expedition to colonize a distant planet. When they uncover disturbing secrets about the mission, they defy their training and begin to explore their most primitive natures. As life on the ship descends into chaos, they soon become consumed by fear, lust and an insatiable hunger for power.

items.title: Upside-Down Magic
items.tagline: Find your magic.
items.overview: Nory and her best friend Reina enter the Sage Academy for Magical Studies, where Nory’s unconventional powers land her in a class for those with wonky, or “upside-down,” magic. Undaunted, Nory sets out to prove that that upside-down magic can be just as powerful as right-side-up.
